question:
Choose the correct option that completes the sentence logically and grammatically:

The tutor asked us _____ our homework on time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to do**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**asked**" is often followed by "**to" + base form of the verb** (infinitive).
 
• The correct structure is "**asked us to do**".
 
• The other options do not fit the grammatical structure required after "**asked**."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *The tutor asked us to do__ our homework on time.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Do**: This would be incorrect as "asked" should be followed by an infinitive verb.
 
• **Doing**: This form is incorrect as it does not fit the sentence structure after "asked".
 
• **Did**: This is the past tense form and does not logically fit in the sentence.
